```{r load_precomputed}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(maps)

# Load all pre-extracted data (run extract_timeseries.R first)
data_file <- "/projectnb/dietzelab/cwebb16/SDA/Validations/timeseries_data.Rdata"
if (!file.exists(data_file)) stop("Run extract_timeseries.R first to generate ", data_file)
load(data_file)

# Load flux CV if available (run extract_flux_cv.R to generate)
flux_file <- "/projectnb/dietzelab/cwebb16/SDA/Validations/flux_cv_data.Rdata"
if (file.exists(flux_file)) load(flux_file)
# Provides: model_df, forecast_df, obs_df, site_info_df, focus_sites, abg_delta,
#           fia_resid_delta, site_unc, gwbi_scatter,
#           compromise_df, compromise_site,
#           runs, years, state_vars

# Convert SoilMoistFrac from decimal (0-1) to percent (0-100) for model and obs
model_df <- model_df %>%
  mutate(Mean         = ifelse(variable == "SoilMoistFrac", Mean         * 100, Mean),
         SD           = ifelse(variable == "SoilMoistFrac", SD           * 100, SD),
         Mean_shifted = ifelse(variable == "SoilMoistFrac", Mean_shifted * 100, Mean_shifted))


obs_df <- obs_df %>%
  mutate(Obs = ifelse(variable == "SoilMoistFrac", Obs * 100, Obs))


run_colors_all <- c(
  "base"         = "grey50",
  "+GWBI"        = "gold3",
  "+LT"          = "darkorange",
  "+LT_GWBI"     = "red3",
  "+FIA"         = "dodgerblue",
  "+FIA_GWBI"    = "navy",
  "+LT_FIA"      = "orchid4",
  "+LT_FIA_GWBI" = "forestgreen"
)

var_labels_ts <- c(
  AbvGrndWood   = "Aboveground Wood (Mg C/ha)",
  LAI           = "LAI (m²/m²)",
  SoilMoistFrac = "Soil Moisture (%)",
  TotSoilCarb   = "Total Soil Carbon (Mg C/ha)",
  GWBI          = "GWBI (Mg C/ha/yr)"
)
```

## Site Locations

```{r site_elevation_map, fig.width=9, fig.height=7, cache=TRUE}
library(elevatr)
library(terra)
library(sf)

# AZ state extent
az_xlim <- c(-115.0, -108.8)
az_ylim <- c(31.2,   37.1)

# AZ polygon as sf for masking
az_sf <- st_as_sf(map("state", regions = "arizona", plot = FALSE, fill = TRUE))

# Download DEM covering full AZ extent (z=7 ~1km resolution)
az_bbox <- data.frame(x = az_xlim, y = az_ylim)
elev_rast <- get_elev_raster(az_bbox, prj = "EPSG:4326", z = 7, src = "aws",
                              clip = "bbox", expand = 0)

# Mask DEM to AZ border
elev_terra <- rast(elev_rast)
az_vect    <- vect(az_sf)
elev_masked <- mask(elev_terra, az_vect)

elev_df <- as.data.frame(elev_masked, xy = TRUE)
names(elev_df)[3] <- "elevation"
elev_df <- elev_df %>% filter(!is.na(elevation))

az_map <- map_data("state", region = "arizona")

site_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_raster(data = elev_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = elevation)) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#4a7c3f", high = "#f5f0e8",
                      name = "Elevation (m)", na.value = NA) +
  geom_polygon(data = az_map, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
               fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(data = site_info_df %>% filter(lon >= az_xlim[1], lon <= az_xlim[2],
                                             lat >= az_ylim[1], lat <= az_ylim[2]),
             aes(x = lon, y = lat),
             shape = 21, fill = "darkorange", color = "black",
             size = 3, stroke = 0.6) +
  coord_fixed(1.3, xlim = az_xlim, ylim = az_ylim) +
  labs(x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

site_map
ggsave("/projectnb/dietzelab/cwebb16/SDA/Validations/figures/az_site_map.png",
       site_map, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r focus_site_table}
site_summary <- site_info_df %>%
  filter(site_idx %in% focus_sites) %>%
  left_join(
    abg_delta %>% filter(run == "+FIA") %>%
      select(site_idx, base_sd, mean_sd, delta_pct),
    by = "site_idx"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    role      = ifelse(delta_pct == max(delta_pct), "Max reduction", "Max increase"),
    base_sd   = round(base_sd, 3),
    mean_sd   = round(mean_sd, 3),
    delta_pct = round(delta_pct, 1)
  ) %>%
  select(role, site_idx, lat, lon, base_sd, mean_sd, delta_pct)

kable(site_summary, format = "html",
      col.names = c("Role", "Site Index", "Lat", "Lon",
                    "Base AGB SD", "+FIA AGB SD", "% Change")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r ts_plot_fn}
plot_ts <- function(var, site_id, y_max = NULL, y_min = NULL, data = model_df, type_label = NULL) {
  df <- data %>%
    filter(variable == var, site_idx == site_id) %>%
    left_join(obs_df %>% filter(variable == var, site_idx == site_id),
              by = c("year", "site_idx", "variable")) %>%
    mutate(run  = factor(run, levels = c("base", "+LT", "+LT_GWBI", "+FIA", "+FIA_GWBI", "+LT_FIA", "+LT_FIA_GWBI", "+GWBI")),
           Date = as.Date(ISOdate(year, 7, 15)))

  # Clamp mean line and ribbon to y_max / y_min
  if (!is.null(y_max)) df <- df %>% mutate(Mean_shifted = pmin(Mean_shifted, y_max))
  if (!is.null(y_min)) df <- df %>% mutate(Mean_shifted = pmax(Mean_shifted, y_min))

  y_hi <- if (!is.null(y_max)) y_max else NULL
  y_lo <- if (!is.null(y_min)) y_min else NULL

  ggplot(df, aes(x = Date)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = if (!is.null(y_min)) pmax(Mean_shifted - SD, y_min) else Mean_shifted - SD,
                    ymax = if (!is.null(y_max)) pmin(Mean_shifted + SD, y_max) else Mean_shifted + SD,
                    fill = run),
                alpha = 0.18, color = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_line(aes(y = Mean_shifted, color = run), linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_line(aes(y = Obs), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9,
              color = "black", na.rm = TRUE) +
    { if (var == "AbvGrndWood") {
        lt  <- lt_obs_df  %>% filter(site_idx == site_id) %>%
                 mutate(Date = as.Date(ISOdate(year, 7, 15)))
        fia <- fia_obs_df %>% filter(site_idx == site_id) %>%
                 mutate(Date = as.Date(ISOdate(year, 7, 15)))
        list(
          geom_line(data = lt,  aes(x = Date, y = LT_obs),
                    linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9, color = "darkorange", inherit.aes = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE),
          geom_line(data = fia, aes(x = Date, y = FIA_obs),
                    linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9, color = "dodgerblue", inherit.aes = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
        )
    }} +
    { if (var == "GWBI") {
        gw <- gwbi_obs_df %>% filter(site_idx == site_id) %>%
                mutate(Date = as.Date(ISOdate(year, 7, 15)))
        geom_line(data = gw, aes(x = Date, y = GWBI_obs),
                  linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9, color = "black", inherit.aes = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
    }} +
    scale_color_manual(values = run_colors_all, name = "Run",
                       breaks = names(run_colors_all)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = run_colors_all, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
    { if (!is.null(y_hi) || !is.null(y_lo)) coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_lo, y_hi)) } +
    labs(title   = paste0(if (!is.null(type_label)) paste0("[", type_label, "]  ") else "",
                          var_labels_ts[var], "  -  Site ", site_id),
         x = "Year", y = var_labels_ts[var],
         caption = "Solid = ensemble mean +/- 1 SD; Dashed = observations") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.text     = element_text(size = 9),
          axis.text       = element_text(size = 10))
}
```

```{r median_ts_fn_early, include=FALSE}
plot_ts_median <- function(var, ribbon_max = NULL, data = model_df, type_label = NULL) {
  med_df <- data %>%
    filter(variable == var) %>%
    group_by(run, year) %>%
    summarise(
      med   = median(Mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      q25   = quantile(Mean, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      q75   = quantile(Mean, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(q75 = if (!is.null(ribbon_max)) pmin(q75, ribbon_max) else q75) %>%
    mutate(run  = factor(run, levels = c("base", "+LT", "+LT_GWBI", "+FIA", "+FIA_GWBI", "+LT_FIA", "+LT_FIA_GWBI", "+GWBI")),
           Date = as.Date(ISOdate(year, 7, 15)))

  obs_med <- obs_df %>%
    filter(variable == var) %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    summarise(med_obs = median(Obs, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Date = as.Date(ISOdate(year, 7, 15)))

  p <- ggplot(med_df, aes(x = Date)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q25, ymax = q75, fill = run),
                alpha = 0.15, color = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_line(aes(y = med, color = run), linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_line(data = obs_med, aes(x = Date, y = med_obs),
              linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9, color = "black", na.rm = TRUE)

  if (var == "AbvGrndWood") {
    lt_med  <- lt_obs_df  %>% group_by(year) %>%
      summarise(v = median(LT_obs,  na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(Date = as.Date(ISOdate(year, 7, 15)))
    fia_med <- fia_obs_df %>% group_by(year) %>%
      summarise(v = median(FIA_obs, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(Date = as.Date(ISOdate(year, 7, 15)))
    p <- p +
      geom_line(data = lt_med,  aes(x = Date, y = v),
                linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9, color = "darkorange", inherit.aes = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
      geom_line(data = fia_med, aes(x = Date, y = v),
                linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9, color = "dodgerblue", inherit.aes = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  if (var == "GWBI") {
    gw_med <- gwbi_obs_df %>% group_by(year) %>%
      summarise(v = median(GWBI_obs, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(Date = as.Date(ISOdate(year, 7, 15)))
    p <- p +
      geom_line(data = gw_med, aes(x = Date, y = v),
                linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9, color = "black", inherit.aes = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  p +
    scale_color_manual(values = run_colors_all, name = "Run", breaks = names(run_colors_all)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = run_colors_all, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
    labs(title   = paste0(if (!is.null(type_label)) paste0("[", type_label, "]  ") else "",
                          var_labels_ts[var], "  -  Median Across All Sites"),
         x = "Year", y = var_labels_ts[var],
         caption = "Solid = site median  |  Ribbon = IQR  |  Dashed = median observation") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.text     = element_text(size = 9),
          axis.text       = element_text(size = 10))
}
```

```{r ts_agb_gwbi_panel, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
library(patchwork)

# Helper: clean median panel
med_panel <- function(var, df, ylims = NULL, show_x = FALSE) {
  p <- plot_ts_median(var, data = df) +
    labs(title = NULL, caption = NULL) +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(4, 8, 4, 8))
  if (!show_x) p <- p + labs(x = NULL) + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())

}
```

## Median Timeseries Across All Sites

```{r median_ts_fn}
plot_ts_median <- function(var, ribbon_max = NULL, data = model_df, type_label = NULL) {
  # Median + IQR across sites per run x year
  med_df <- data %>%
    filter(variable == var) %>%
    group_by(run, year) %>%
    summarise(
      med   = median(Mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      q25   = quantile(Mean, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      q75   = quantile(Mean, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(q75 = if (!is.null(ribbon_max)) pmin(q75, ribbon_max) else q75) %>%
    mutate(run  = factor(run, levels = c("base", "+LT", "+LT_GWBI", "+FIA", "+FIA_GWBI", "+LT_FIA", "+LT_FIA_GWBI", "+GWBI")),
           Date = as.Date(ISOdate(year, 7, 15)))

  # Median obs across sites per year
  obs_med <- obs_df %>%
    filter(variable == var) %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    summarise(med_obs = median(Obs, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Date = as.Date(ISOdate(year, 7, 15)))

  p <- ggplot(med_df, aes(x = Date)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q25, ymax = q75, fill = run),
                alpha = 0.15, color = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_line(aes(y = med, color = run), linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_line(data = obs_med, aes(x = Date, y = med_obs),
              linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9, color = "black", na.rm = TRUE)

  # Variable-specific obs overlays
  if (var == "AbvGrndWood") {
    lt_med  <- lt_obs_df  %>% group_by(year) %>%
      summarise(v = median(LT_obs,  na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(Date = as.Date(ISOdate(year, 7, 15)))
    fia_med <- fia_obs_df %>% group_by(year) %>%
      summarise(v = median(FIA_obs, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(Date = as.Date(ISOdate(year, 7, 15)))
    p <- p +
      geom_line(data = lt_med,  aes(x = Date, y = v),
                linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9, color = "darkorange", inherit.aes = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) +
      geom_line(data = fia_med, aes(x = Date, y = v),
                linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9, color = "dodgerblue", inherit.aes = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  if (var == "GWBI") {
    gw_med <- gwbi_obs_df %>% group_by(year) %>%
      summarise(v = median(GWBI_obs, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(Date = as.Date(ISOdate(year, 7, 15)))
    p <- p +
      geom_line(data = gw_med, aes(x = Date, y = v),
                linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9, color = "black", inherit.aes = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  p +
    scale_color_manual(values = run_colors_all, name = "Run", breaks = names(run_colors_all)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = run_colors_all, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
    labs(title   = paste0(if (!is.null(type_label)) paste0("[", type_label, "]  ") else "",
                          var_labels_ts[var], "  -  Median Across All Sites"),
         x = "Year", y = var_labels_ts[var],
         caption = "Solid = site median  |  Ribbon = IQR  |  Dashed = median observation") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.text     = element_text(size = 9),
          axis.text       = element_text(size = 10))
}
```

## State Variable Uncertainty

```{r load_and_compute}
library(purrr)
library(PEcAn.settings)

runs_unc  <- c("base", "+GWBI", "+LT", "+LT_GWBI", "+FIA", "+FIA_GWBI", "+LT_FIA", "+LT_FIA_GWBI")
base_dir  <- "/projectnb/dietzelab/cwebb16/SDA_runs"
sda_files <- file.path(base_dir, runs_unc, "sda.all.forecast.analysis.Rdata")

state_vars_u <- c("AbvGrndWood", "LAI", "SoilMoistFrac", "TotSoilCarb", "GWBI")
n_state_u    <- length(state_vars_u)

var_labels_u <- c(
  "AbvGrndWood"   = "Wood",
  "LAI"           = "LAI",
  "SoilMoistFrac" = "Soil Moist",
  "TotSoilCarb"   = "Soil C",
  "GWBI"          = "GWBI"
)

analysis_list <- setNames(vector("list", length(runs_unc)), runs_unc)
for (i in seq_along(runs_unc)) {
  e <- new.env()
  load(sda_files[i], envir = e)
  analysis_list[[runs_unc[i]]] <- e$analysis.all
  rm(e)
}

get_var_cols_u <- function(var, mat) {
  uniq <- unique(colnames(mat))
  v    <- which(uniq == var)
  if (!length(v)) return(integer(0))
  v + (0:(ncol(mat) / n_state_u - 1)) * n_state_u
}

compute_site_year_stats <- function(al, var) {
  stats <- lapply(al, function(mat) {
    cols <- get_var_cols_u(var, mat)
    if (!length(cols)) return(NULL)
    t(apply(as.matrix(mat)[, cols, drop = FALSE], 2, function(ens) {
      ens <- ens[is.finite(ens)]
      if (length(ens) < 5) return(c(cv = NA_real_, abs_sd = NA_real_))
      m <- mean(ens); s <- sd(ens)
      cv <- if (abs(m) < 1e-6 || !is.finite(s/abs(m)) || s/abs(m) > 5) NA_real_ else s/abs(m)
      c(cv = cv, abs_sd = if (is.finite(s)) s else NA_real_)
    }))
  })
  df <- do.call(rbind, stats)
  list(cv = mean(df[, "cv"], na.rm = TRUE),
       abs_sd = mean(df[, "abs_sd"], na.rm = TRUE))
}

results <- data.frame()
for (var in state_vars_u) {
  base_stats <- compute_site_year_stats(analysis_list[["base"]], var)
  for (r in runs_unc) {
    rs <- compute_site_year_stats(analysis_list[[r]], var)
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      run        = r,
      variable   = var,
      cv         = rs$cv,
      abs_sd     = rs$abs_sd,
      pct_inc_cv = 100 * (rs$cv     - base_stats$cv)     / base_stats$cv,
      pct_inc_sd = 100 * (rs$abs_sd - base_stats$abs_sd) / base_stats$abs_sd,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
}

# Merge flux delta CV into results if available
results_full <- if (exists("flux_delta_cv")) {
  bind_rows(results, flux_delta_cv %>% select(run, variable, pct_inc_cv))
} else {
  results
}
```

### Baseline CV

```{r base_cv_table}
base_cv <- results %>%
```

```{r pct_cv_table}

all_labels <- c(
```

## Uncertainty Bubble Plot

Bubble size = magnitude of % CV change. **Green** = reduction; **Purple** = increase

```{r bubble_plot, fig.width=20, fig.height=8, dpi=150}
library(forcats)

run_order <- c("+LT", "+FIA", "+LT_GWBI", "+FIA_GWBI", "+GWBI", "+LT_FIA", "+LT_FIA_GWBI")

row_colors <- c(
  "+LT_FIA"      = "pink",
  "+GWBI"        = "yellow",
  "+FIA_GWBI"    = "blue",
  "+LT_GWBI"     = "green",
  "+FIA"         = "purple",
  "+LT"          = "orange",
  "+LT_FIA_GWBI" = "lightblue"
)

all_var_labels <- c(
  "AbvGrndWood"   = "AGB",
  "LAI"           = "LAI",
  "SoilMoistFrac" = "Soil Moisture",
  "TotSoilCarb"   = "Soil C",
  "GWBI"          = "GWBI",
  "GPP"           = "GPP",
  "AutoResp"      = "Auto",
  "HeteroResp"    = "Hetero",
  "Transp"        = "Transp"
)

make_bubble_plot <- function(df, inc_col) {
  df <- df %>%
    filter(run != "base") %>%
    filter(is.finite(.data[[inc_col]])) %>%
    mutate(color    = ifelse(.data[[inc_col]] < 0, "Decrease", "Increase"),
           size_val = abs(.data[[inc_col]]))

  df$run      <- factor(df$run, levels = run_order)
  df$variable <- factor(df$variable,
                        levels = intersect(names(all_var_labels), unique(df$variable)))
  levels(df$variable) <- all_var_labels[levels(df$variable)]

  n_runs <- length(levels(df$run))
  n_vars <- length(levels(df$variable))
  run_levels_rev <- rev(levels(df$run))

  # Alternating light/dark grey rows
  rect_df <- data.frame(
    ymin = seq(0.5, n_runs - 0.5, 1),
    ymax = seq(1.5, n_runs + 0.5, 1),
    fill = rep(c("grey88", "grey76"), length.out = n_runs)
  )

  ggplot(df, aes(x = variable, y = fct_rev(run), fill = color, size = size_val)) +
    mapply(function(ymin, ymax, fill)
      annotate("rect", xmin = 0.4, xmax = n_vars + 0.6,
               ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, alpha = 1, fill = fill),
      ymin = rect_df$ymin, ymax = rect_df$ymax,
      fill = rect_df$fill, SIMPLIFY = FALSE) +
    geom_point(shape = 21, stroke = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = seq(0.5, n_runs + 0.5, 1),
               linewidth = 0.25, colour = "grey60") +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Decrease" = "#2ecc71", "Increase" = "#e67e22"),
                      name = "Direction",
                      guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 10))) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(4, 30), name = expression(Delta*"CV from Base (%)")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.grid       = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey88", color = NA),
      legend.position  = "right",
      axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 22),
      axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 22, margin = margin(r = 10)),
      axis.title.y     = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
      legend.title     = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 21),
      plot.title       = element_blank()
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "SDA Configuration")
}

bubble_p <- make_bubble_plot(results_full, "pct_inc_cv")
bubble_p
ggsave("/projectnb/dietzelab/cwebb16/SDA/Validations/figures/bubble_plot.png",
       bubble_p, width = 20, height = 8, dpi = 150, bg = "white")
```

## Residual RMSE by Run and Observation Type

RMSE of analysis posteriors vs LandTrendr AGB, FIA AGB, and FIA GWBI observations

```{r rmse_compute}
rmse_runs <- c("base", "+LT", "+FIA", "+GWBI", "+LT_FIA", "+LT_GWBI",
               "+FIA_GWBI", "+LT_FIA_GWBI")

agb_analysis  <- model_df %>% filter(variable == "AbvGrndWood")
gwbi_analysis <- model_df %>% filter(variable == "GWBI")

rmse_lt <- agb_analysis %>%
  filter(run %in% rmse_runs) %>%
  inner_join(lt_obs_df, by = c("year", "site_idx")) %>%
  group_by(run) %>%
  summarise(rmse = sqrt(mean((Mean - LT_obs)^2, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(obs_type = "LT AGB")

rmse_fia <- agb_analysis %>%
  filter(run %in% rmse_runs) %>%
  inner_join(fia_obs_df, by = c("year", "site_idx")) %>%
  group_by(run) %>%
  summarise(rmse = sqrt(mean((Mean - FIA_obs)^2, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(obs_type = "FIA AGB")

rmse_gwbi <- gwbi_analysis %>%
  filter(run %in% rmse_runs) %>%
  inner_join(gwbi_obs_df, by = c("year", "site_idx")) %>%
  group_by(run) %>%
  summarise(rmse = sqrt(mean((Mean - GWBI_obs)^2, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(obs_type = "FIA GWBI")

rmse_df <- bind_rows(rmse_lt, rmse_fia, rmse_gwbi) %>%
  mutate(obs_type = factor(obs_type, levels = c("LT AGB", "FIA AGB", "FIA GWBI")),
         run      = factor(run, levels = rmse_runs))

base_rmse <- rmse_df %>% filter(run == "base") %>%
  select(obs_type, base_rmse = rmse)

rmse_delta <- rmse_df %>%
  filter(run != "base") %>%
  left_join(base_rmse, by = "obs_type") %>%
  mutate(delta_rmse = rmse - base_rmse,
         pct_change = 100 * delta_rmse / base_rmse,
         color      = ifelse(delta_rmse < 0, "Decrease", "Increase"),
         size_val   = abs(pct_change),
         run        = factor(run, levels = run_order))
```

### % Change in RMSE vs Base

**Green** = RMSE decreased; **Purple** = RMSE increased

```{r rmse_pct_table}
color_cell_rmse <- function(x) {
  cell_spec(
    ifelse(is.na(x), "-", paste0(round(x, 1), "%")),
    format     = "html",
    background = ifelse(is.na(x), "white",
                        ifelse(x < 0, "#c8f7c5", "thistle")),
    color = "black", bold = FALSE
  )
}

rmse_pct_wide <- rmse_delta %>%
  select(run, obs_type, pct_change) %>%
  mutate(run = as.character(run)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = obs_type, values_from = pct_change) %>%
  mutate(across(-run, color_cell_rmse))

kable(rmse_pct_wide, format = "html", escape = FALSE,
      col.names = c("Run", "LT AGB", "FIA AGB", "FIA GWBI")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("hover", "condensed", "bordered"),
                full_width = TRUE, position = "left") %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, background = "#f5f5f5")
```

## Per-Site AGB Uncertainty Reduction (LT vs FIA)

### Scatterplot

Each point is one site. Points **above** the 1:1 line = FIA reduces more uncertainty;
**below** = LandTrendr reduces more

```{r unc_reduction_scatter, fig.width=7, fig.height=6}
ax_max <- max(c(site_unc$red_lt, site_unc$red_fia), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05
ax_min <- min(c(site_unc$red_lt, site_unc$red_fia), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05

ggplot(site_unc, aes(x = red_lt, y = red_fia)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
              color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2, aes(color = delta)) +
  scale_color_distiller(
    palette   = "RdBu",
    limits    = c(-1, 1) * quantile(abs(site_unc$delta), 0.85, na.rm = TRUE),
    oob       = scales::squish,
    direction = 1,
    name      = "FIA − LT\nreduction (%)"
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = ax_max * 0.05, y = ax_max * 0.92,
           label = "FIA reduces\nmore uncertainty", hjust = 0,
           size = 3.5, color = "grey40") +
  annotate("text", x = ax_max * 0.55, y = ax_max * 0.05,
           label = "LT reduces\nmore uncertainty", hjust = 0,
           size = 3.5, color = "grey40") +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(ax_min, ax_max), ylim = c(ax_min, ax_max)) +
  labs(title = "FIA vs LandTrendr Per-Site AGB Uncertainty Reduction",
       x     = "+LT vs base % CV reduction",
       y     = "+FIA vs base % CV reduction") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
        axis.text    = element_text(size = 10))
```

## LT-FIA Compromise

For each site-year where both LandTrendr and FIA observations exist and differ by more than 1 Mg C/ha, this shows how far the +LT_FIA analysis moved from LT toward FIA:

<p style="text-align:center; font-size:1.05em;">
position = (analysis &minus; FIA obs) / (LT obs &minus; FIA obs)
</p>

**1 = stayed at LT, 0 = moved fully to FIA, 0.5 = equal compromise**

```{r compromise_hist, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
med_pos  <- median(compromise_df$position, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_pos <- mean(compromise_df$position,   na.rm = TRUE)

view_lo <- -0.3
view_hi <-  1.5

p_hist <- ggplot(compromise_df, aes(x = position)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = view_lo, xmax = 0, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "tomato", alpha = 0.12) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 1, xmax = view_hi, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "tomato", alpha = 0.12) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "#1b9e77", color = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,       linetype = "solid",  color = "grey40",    linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1,       linetype = "solid",  color = "grey40",    linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5,     linetype = "dashed", color = "black",     linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = med_pos, linetype = "solid",  color = "darkorange", linewidth = 0.9) +
  annotate("text", x = view_hi, y = Inf, vjust = 1.5, hjust = 1,
           label = paste0("median = ", round(med_pos, 2)), color = "darkorange", size = 3.5) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.53, y = Inf, vjust = 3, hjust = 0,
           label = "equal split", color = "black", size = 3.2) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
    labels = c("FIA", "0.25", "Equal\n(0.5)", "0.75", "LT")
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(view_lo, view_hi)) +
  labs(x = "Position between FIA and LT", y = "Count (site/years)", title = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)

p_scatter <- ggplot(compromise_site, aes(x = mean_obs_range, y = mean_position)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2, color = "#1b9e77") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "darkorange", linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(x = "Mean LT − FIA (Mg C/ha)", y = "Mean position", title = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)

compromise_plot <- p_hist / p_scatter +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))
compromise_plot
ggsave("/projectnb/dietzelab/cwebb16/SDA/Validations/figures/compromise_plot.png",
       compromise_plot, width = 8, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
